conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces overall portfolio risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions, but may limit upside potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall concentration and leverage while introducing new, high-quality long setups. Expect moderate drawdowns with this approach.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. This approach significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs decay daily. Strict stop discipline is critical to manage the higher risk.

plan: To prioritize income, SPY will be trimmed to 20% to cure concentration.
QQQI will be increased to 30% to enhance monthly distributions.
QQQ, CRWD, and SMH will be sold to zero to reduce growth-oriented and high-beta exposure.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
